# Authorized Standard-Return Refund Amounts
Applies to: Northstar refund settlement batches for authorized orders with return_type `standard`.

Before submitting, search the learned rules for updates and look up the order. If an applicable learned update specifies the amount, use it rather than the legacy invoice-total fallback. For standard returns under the observed current policy, refund `merchandise_paid_cents` only; do not include outbound shipping. Do not infer the amount from `invoice_total_cents` when this policy applies. Check the amount before the batch's single submission, since a rejection closes the batch and cannot be repaired in the same task. Use the order ID as `idempotency_key` unless an applicable update says otherwise. Report posted status from the submission response; never describe a rejected refund as successful.
